ecal_cleaning_diagnostics.filter: HiEcalRecHitSpikeFilter (EcalRecHitsEB, minEt=20.0 GeV, swissThreshold=0.95, timeThreshold=4.0 ns, avoidIeta85=False)

validation_checks.nprob_rbx_note: In CMSSW_3_9_2_patch5 RECO, HcalNoiseSummary.nproblemRBXs_ uses pp occupancy thresholds and flags 36-38 HB RBXs in central PbPb collisions (111 / 55052 cleaned HLT_HIJet50U events have nproblemRBXs_ == 0, all ultra-peripheral). Following 2010 HI EventSelection_cff.py, offline cleaning combines HiEcalRecHitSpikeFilter on EcalRecHitsEB (minEt=20 GeV, swissThreshold=0.95, avoidIeta85=False, |time|<=4 ns) with HCAL maxzeros_ < 100, pixel-HF scraping rejection, and jet EMF >= 0.01.
